reviewer.method: Read-only comparison of the PRD against M07-PRD-v1 and cited Discovery/task sources

criteria.evidence: Goals, rule/requirement origins, and the traceability table link source problems to workflows, BR/FR/NFR/AC, and metrics.
Requirements define observable outcomes; implementation modules, algorithms, schemas, edits, and tools remain for SPEC.
Production/test/build relationships, unknown public status, neutral-target scope, exceptions, dirty-candidate baseline, and freshness are explicit.
AC1-AC9 and MET1-MET6 cover measurable inventory, declarations, exports, direction, project references, compatibility, evidence, and stage gates.
Local/synthetic scope, human approval or handoff for sensitive actions, explicit clinical/financial/record/appointment/RAG limits, closed G21-5/G21-6, and production NO_GO are stated.
R1-R6 and OQ1-OQ4 preserve candidate freshness, public package set, project-reference semantics, exception ownership, static-analysis limits, and unresolved ownership.

independent_final_critic.reason: The agent service rejected starting a new fresh-context critic because its thread limit was reached. No independent approval is claimed.

integrated_verification.reason: Documentary PRD stage; no code, build, test, service, database, or runtime action was authorized or performed.

resource_stop.reason: The Gauntlet wall-clock envelope elapsed before an independent Final Critic could be obtained.

human_decision.post_approval_change: Gate status, updated timestamp, and next-gate metadata only; PRD requirements were not changed.
